name: suwageval
description: Evaluate and monitor an LLM agent with Suwageval from Claude Code: write scenarios as files in the agent's repository, keep them valid, run them and explain what failed, turn a real conversation of the deployed agent into a scenario (/suwageval:scenario, fix, run, from-conversation, versions, update), and a session hook that brings the loop conversation → scenario → run → why into every session in an agent's repository.
